description: The aggregate forecast of AI researchers for a 50% chance of full automation of labor shifted from 2164 in 2022 to 2116 in 2023.

instances.assertion: The aggregate forecast of AI researchers for a 50% chance of full automation of labor shifted from 2164 in 2022 to 2116 in 2023.
The aggregate forecast of AI researchers in 2023 gave a 50% chance of full automation of labor by 2116, down 48 years from 2164 in 2022.
